remarks: RARE TOP-FLOOR, TWO-STORY CONDO IN THE HEART OF INGLEWOOD! This spacious 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom residence offers approximately 1,490 square feet of living space, soaring ceilings, abundant natural light, and one of the larger floor plans in the community. Step inside to a welcoming living room featuring recessed lighting, engineered hardwood floors, granite countertops, and a striking see-through gas fireplace that creates a warm connection between the living and dining areas. The adjacent dining area includes a convenient wet bar with granite counters perfect for entertaining.
